items.title: Applying Troubleshooting and Preventive Measures (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Applying Troubleshooting and Preventive Measures (PDF 128, printed 124).

blocks.text: Jab koi security masla mile to troubleshooting (masle ki jaanch) us ki wajah aur hal maloom karne mein madad deti hai. Bachao ke tareeqon (preventive measures) mein firewalls, antiviruses aur anti-malware install karna, software update karna, passwords badalna ya nuqsan-deh files hatana shamil hain. Kuch soorton mein backups se data wapas lana (restore) zaroori ho sakta hai. Masla aur us ke liye uthaye gaye qadam likh lena (document karna) use dobara hone se rokta hai.

blocks.prompt: Security masla milne par preventive measures (bachao ke qadam) kya hain, aur masla aur qadam likh lena kyun faidemand hai?
blocks.explanation: Firewalls, antivirus aur anti-malware install karna, software update karna, passwords badalna, nuqsan deh files hatana; zaroorat ho to backup se data wapas lana. Likh lene (documenting) se yahi masla dobara nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: Poore section 9.2 ka jaiza: Aap ko email aati hai: 'Aap ka bank account band hai. Yahan click kar ke 1 ghante mein apna PIN dalein.' Yeh kis qism ka hamla hai, aur aap ko kya karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Phishing: yeh jaldi ka dabao dalti aur link ke zariye khufia tafseel mangti hai. Click ya jawab na dein; bank se us ke sarkari number ya app se rabta karein, email report kar ke delete karein. Banks kabhi email se PIN nahi mangte.

items: Troubleshooting: masle ki wajah aur hal dhoondna.
